scripts.reset-owner-pass: node -e "const {openDatabase}=require('./sqlite-adapter'),b=require('bcryptjs'); openDatabase('data.db').then(db=>{ db.prepare('update users set hash=? where role=\'owner\'').run(b.hashSync('NewPass123',10)); db.saveNow(); console.log('Owner password reset to NewPass123 for mobile 9422556644'); process.exit(0); })"
scripts.reset-login: node -e "const {openDatabase}=require('./sqlite-adapter'); openDatabase('data.db').then(d=>{ d.exec('delete from sessions; delete from users;'); d.saveNow(); console.log('Login credentials reset.'); process.exit(0); })"
